text:
Maria: Heads up — I've been seeing steady memory growth in the KV cache for long-chat sessions (>8k tokens) after the allocator tweak two weeks ago. Sharing a tiny profiler snapshot below.

Oliver: Can you paste the numbers? :eyes: 

Maria: ```
kv_cache.used: 22.8GB -> 25.6GB (10h session)
free_frag: 3.2GB (avg free chunk: 128B)
alloc_requests: +18% small-blocks (<256B)
compactions: triggered 1/480s -> 1/600s
page_faults: +4%

notes: long-lived KV entries with intermittent small updates.
```

Ken: That avg free chunk size is a red flag — allocator appears to be slicing slabs into many tiny pieces.

Zara: Did we change the minimal allocation unit in the last rollout?

Maria: Yes, we lowered minimal block size from 128B -> 64B to reduce internal waste for short-lived requests.

Oliver: That helps short contexts but will amplify fragmentation for long-lived KV caches — tradeoff expected. :/ 

Maria: Proposal sketch: preemptive consolidation pass when free_frag > 2GB OR free_frag_ratio > 0.08, but avoid running during p99 latency windows.

Ken: Also consider lazy coalescing of adjacent free small blocks into larger slabs during low load windows instead of aggressive realtime compaction.

Zara: We could bump incremental compaction frequency for Dedicated nodes only (e.g., 1/600s -> 1/300s) to keep production latency risk lower for Hosted.

ops-bot: deploy-check: canary pool 12/16 nodes healthy, no recent OOMs, compaction jobs nominal.

Maria: Another idea: growth hysteresis — only expand slab pool after consecutive growth spikes > 3 samples and avoid splitting blocks <128B unless allocation profile shows high short-lived allocation rate.

Oliver: We should reproduce with a longcontext-sim workload (8k-12k token sessions) plus many short-lived allocations to emulate churn.

Maria: I'll schedule a 24h sim on staging and collect heap diffs + flamegraphs.

Ken: If staging repros, add a background compaction thread with a strict rate limit and a latency-safe backoff.

Zara: Caution: background compaction can cause latency bumps if it competes with kernels; tie it to batching low-load windows.

Maria: Agreed. Proposed compaction config to experiment with:```
compactor.rate_limit_tokens_per_sec = 20000
compactor.max_pause_ms = 10
compactor.min_free_frag_trigger = 1 << 30  # 1GB
```

Oliver: SGTM. Also collect kv_alloc histograms, slab occupancy over time, and small-block reuse rate.

Maria: Will upload graphs tomorrow. Quick question — anyone opposed to trying min-block size = 128B in the canary pool and observing memory tail behavior?

Ken: +1 for canary, gate on p50/p95 mem and tail latencies, need rollback playbook.

Zara: +1 assuming rollback and metrics alerts in place.

Maria: Cool. I'll file a follow-up PR with the canary config, schedule the sim, and attach the simulated heap diffs. Thanks :thumbsup:
